name: Beispiel Hochwassergefahrenkarten
description: This dataset holds flood hazard maps for a fictitious German river basin: inundation extent and depth rasters for return periods of 10, 100 and 200 years, plus the dyke lines that were assumed in the hydraulic model. It is produced by the Beispielamt für Gewässerkunde, a federal water agency, to support flood risk management planning under national regulation. Coverage is national at 10 metre resolution, with the reference year 2024; the rasters are a snapshot and are updated every six years. Access is through a WMS and WFS endpoint and bulk GeoTIFF downloads from the portal; metadata is in German with an English summary. The licence is the Datenlizenz Deutschland Namensnennung 2.0 (recorded as free text) and there is no cost, but bulk download requires registration. Caveats: the depth values are model outputs, not observations, and small tributaries are only partially covered. Simulation uses include hazard exposure, resilience and climate adaptation studies of dams, flood defences and interdependent networks. No other catalogued record relates to it yet.
